one-prompt: preview in a browser without canvas filters (#1)

The 2D surface's DPI patch wrapped the context's `filter` property
without checking it was there. Safari has no canvas `filter`, so the
descriptor was undefined and the preview stopped with "fd.set". The
patch is now skipped where the browser has no filter to scale.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
